title: Flight & Hotel Booking Aggregator
description: A platform that searches multiple airline and hotel APIs to find the best deals, allowing users to book integrated itineraries.

modules.name: API Aggregation Engine
modules.description: Concurrently querying dozens of external travel APIs and standardizing responses.

modules.name: Pricing & Caching
modules.description: Caching frequent routes in Redis while ensuring price accuracy.

modules.name: Itinerary Builder
modules.description: Combining flights, hotels, and car rentals into a single logical trip.

modules.name: Payment & Ticketing
modules.description: Processing payments and issuing e-tickets via GDS integrations.

project_objectives: Return aggregated search results in under 3 seconds

title: Vacation Rental Management System
description: A platform for property managers to sync their listings, calendars, and messages across Airbnb, VRBO, and Booking.com.

modules.name: Channel Manager
modules.description: Syncing availability calendars (iCal) to prevent double bookings.

modules.name: Unified Inbox
modules.description: Aggregating guest messages from multiple platforms into one interface.

modules.name: Dynamic Pricing
modules.description: Adjusting nightly rates based on seasonality, local events, and occupancy.

modules.name: Task Automation
modules.description: Automatically scheduling cleaning staff after check-outs.

learning_outcomes: Integrating with major travel platform APIs

title: Ride Booking Platform
description: An Uber-like platform for booking on-demand rides, featuring real-time driver tracking, surge pricing, and rating systems.

modules.name: Driver/Rider Matching
modules.description: Geospatial queries to find the nearest available driver to a rider.

modules.name: Real-Time Tracking
modules.description: WebSocket integration to show the car moving on a map live.

modules.name: Dynamic Pricing Engine
modules.description: Algorithm adjusting prices based on current demand and traffic conditions.

modules.name: Trip Management
modules.description: Handling state transitions (requested, accepted, arrived, in-progress, completed).

project_objectives: Match riders to drivers in under 5 seconds
Accurately track location even with spotty network coverage

title: Travel Itinerary Planning App
description: A collaborative tool for groups to plan trips together. Features drag-and-drop daily schedules, expense splitting, and offline access.

modules.name: Collaborative Planner
modules.description: Real-time synced calendar where multiple users can add destinations.

modules.name: Expense Splitter
modules.description: Calculating who owes whom for shared trip costs.

modules.name: Places Integration
modules.description: Pulling details, photos, and reviews from Google Places API.

modules.name: Offline Mode
modules.description: Caching itinerary data locally so it works without internet while traveling.

project_objectives: Provide seamless offline access to trip plans
Ensure immediate sync of changes when online

title: Corporate Travel Policy Enforcer
description: A system integrated with booking tools that checks flights and hotels against company policies before allowing purchase.

modules.name: Policy Rules Engine
modules.description: Interface for HR to define limits (e.g., max $200/night for hotel, economy flights only).

modules.name: Booking Interceptor
modules.description: API that evaluates proposed itineraries against the rules in real-time.

modules.name: Exception Workflows
modules.description: Routing out-of-policy requests to managers for manual approval.

modules.name: Reporting Dashboard
modules.description: Analytics showing compliance rates and potential savings.
